acceptanceCovered: springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui:2.6.0 added and Swagger UI accessible at /swagger-ui.html in dev profile
Swagger endpoints permitted in SecurityConfig; disabled in prod and test profiles
Facebook OAuth2 login configured with Graph API fields=id,name,email
Twitter OAuth2 login configured with API v2 endpoints and synthetic email fallback
authentication.getName() returns email for all three providers (Google, Facebook, Twitter)
prompt=select_account conditioned to Google only in CustomAuthorizationRequestResolver
regressionChecked: OAuth2 login flow for all three providers
JWT subject / authentication.getName() for Facebook and Twitter users — H1 bug found and fixed
Spring Security filter chain (swagger permitAll additions) — CSRF not applicable to static GET endpoints
Swagger UI availability by profile — disabled in prod and test confirmed
Facebook user data retrieval (name, email) — H2 bug found and fixed via fields query param

findings.summary: Twitter nameAttributeKey='data' caused authentication.getName() to return Map.toString(), breaking JWT subject for all Twitter logins
Facebook Graph API user-info-uri missing ?fields=id,name,email — name and email were always null
User email logged at INFO level in prod — PII exposed in log files with 30-day retention
DefaultOAuth2UserService instantiated as a field rather than injected — harder to mock in tests
Missing worker-src 'self' blob: in CSP — Swagger syntax highlighting workers silently fail
OAuth2AuthenticationException message leaks internal exception detail — low risk in Thymeleaf redirect flow
Swagger endpoints in permitAll — no CSRF concern, all are GET endpoints serving static assets
extractRegistrationId uses lastIndexOf('/') — safe fallback to false for non-Google providers
